meta.title: Z-app — ERPNext for contractors — OpenAEC Foundation
meta.description: Z-app: an open source extension to ERPNext for contractors. Planning of people and equipment, estimates and quotations, hours, progress billing and project margins, with a mobile app for the building site.

header.label: In development
header.tagline: The business system for contractors, on top of ERPNext
header.desc: Z-app extends ERPNext with what a contractor needs every day: planning of people and equipment, estimates and quotations, hours and progress billing. With a mobile app for the building site.

what.label: What is Z-app?
what.title: One system for projects, planning and money
what.desc: ERPNext already handles accounting, purchasing and HR. Z-app adds the work of a contractor to it, in the same database and with the same login.
what.erp: On top of ERPNext A Frappe app you install next to ERPNext. You keep the accounting, purchasing and HR you already have.
what.practice: From practice Built for and with a small construction company, where it is used every day.
what.own: Your own data Runs on your own ERPNext environment. No separate cloud, no licence per user.

modules.label: Modules
modules.heading: What is inside
modules.sub: Three areas of work, with the project at the centre.

planning.title: Planning board
planning.desc: Plan employees, equipment and contacts per project, with your own colours and non-working days.

hours.title: Hours and rates
hours.desc: Hours per employee and project, hourly rates and time-and-materials work already invoiced.

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.desc: Equipment bookings, mileage and the maintenance status of your machines.

estimate.title: Estimate
estimate.desc: Estimate lines per project, with cost codes per chapter to track costs during construction.

quotes.title: Quotations
quotes.desc: Quotations from templates, with attachments, status and reminders. The quoted amount comes from the estimate.

materials.title: Materials and waste
materials.desc: Material and waste bookings per project, with purchase templates for what you order often.

terms.title: Progress billing
terms.desc: Instalments for the client and for subcontractors, with a contract per subcontractor.

margins.title: Project margins
margins.desc: See per project what was budgeted, spent and invoiced, and what is left.

diary.title: Site diary and issues
diary.desc: Daily and weekly site reports, complaints and recurring tasks in one place.

mobile.label: Mobile app
mobile.title: On the building site too
mobile.desc: An app for Android and iOS, built with Tauri 2. You log in with your normal account and see the same screens: whatever changes in Z-app is in the app straight away.
mobile.now: Now A test version for Android; the iPhone version follows through TestFlight.
mobile.next: Next Push notifications, a photo straight into a project and dedicated mobile screens for projects and weekly hours.
mobile.stores: Later In Google Play and the App Store.

frappe.title: Frappe app for ERPNext 16
frappe.desc: Install with bench; doctypes, fields, roles and workspaces come with the app.

tauri.title: Tauri 2 mobile
tauri.desc: The same base as the other OpenAEC apps, for Android and iOS.

yapp.title: Together with the Y-app
yapp.desc: The Y-app is the workspace for your whole company; Z-app adds the contracting work.

cta.title: Join as a contractor?
cta.desc: Z-app is in development and the source code will be made public. Want to use it or help decide what goes in? Email us.
